knowledgeBase.answer: For account or technical issues, please contact our support team. We're here to help quickly.

To sign up as a client, click the Client tab and enter your email, password, first name, last name, phone number, and date of birth. You must be at least 18 years old. After creating your account, you'll complete your wellness profile and then create your first project to find matching practitioners.

To sign up as a practitioner, click the Practitioner tab and enter your legal name, business name, DBA name (if applicable), year you established your practice, business size, phone number, and physical address. After account creation, you'll set up your specialties, services, and coverage areas to start receiving matches.

Your password must be at least 6 characters long. We recommend using a mix of letters, numbers, and special characters for better security. Make sure your passwords match in both the password and confirmation fields.

Please enter a valid email address (like yourname@example.com). Your email must be confirmed in both the email and confirmation fields to match exactly. This email will be used for your login and important account notifications.

keywords: how old do i need to be
knowledgeBase.answer: Clients must be at least 18 years old to create an account. We verify this using your date of birth during signup. Please enter your birthdate accurately.

keywords: what happens after i sign up
knowledgeBase.answer: After you create your account, clients will complete their wellness profile (optional) and then create their first project describing what they're looking for. Practitioners will set up their specialties, service types, pricing, and coverage areas. Then you're ready to start connecting with matches!

Click the 'Forgot Password?' link on the login page and enter your email address. We'll send you a password reset link. Check your email (including spam folder) and follow the link to create a new password.

If you already have a Rooted Vitality account, simply log in with your email and password instead of signing up again. If you forgot your email or password, use the password reset option on the login page.
First, check your spam or promotions folder—emails sometimes end up there. If you still don't see it after 5 minutes, contact our support team and we can help resend it or troubleshoot the issue.

Your phone number is required for account creation so practitioners or clients can contact you. Enter it in your country's standard format (for US, this is typically 10 digits with or without parentheses and dashes).

For practitioners: your legal business name is your official registered business name. Your DBA (Doing Business As) name is what you operate under if different from the legal name—this is optional but helps clients recognize you.

You must accept our terms and conditions to complete signup. These outline how Rooted Vitality works, your rights and responsibilities, and our privacy practices. You can review them anytime in your account settings.

If you've attempted to log in multiple times with the wrong password, your account may be temporarily locked for security. Wait a few minutes and try again, or use the password reset link to create a new password.

After creating a project, clients are shown a list of matching practitioners based on their needs, location, and service preferences. You can browse profiles, see ratings and reviews, check their services and availability, and send connection requests to practitioners you're interested in.

Once you complete your setup, practitioners receive match notifications when clients in your service area create projects matching your specialties. You can review each match and decide whether to accept and connect with the client.

keywords: what do i have to fill in
knowledgeBase.answer: For clients: email, password, first name, last name, phone, and birthdate are required. For practitioners: email, password, legal name, business name, phone, and address are required. All other fields help complete your profile for better matches.

Rooted Vitality is fully accessible on mobile devices. Simply visit our website on your phone's browser and follow the same signup process. All fields are mobile-friendly and easy to complete on smaller screens.

After signing up, you can edit your profile information from your account dashboard. Most fields can be updated anytime. For practitioners, you can also modify your specialties, pricing, and coverage areas from your match settings.

When you click 'Get Started on Your Wellness Journey,' we walk you through a guided onboarding experience. This step-by-step wizard helps you tell us what you're looking for, creates your profile, and connects you with matching practitioners. Each step is designed to make the process warm, personal, and easy.

A wellness project is your request for practitioner support. It captures what you're looking for, your preferred way of connecting (in-person, virtual, or house calls), and your timeline. Once you create a project, we automatically match you with practitioners who can help. You can have multiple projects for different wellness needs.

Your wellness profile is a series of optional questions that help practitioners understand your wellness journey. You share your wellness goals, what challenges you're facing, what you've tried before, your communication preferences, and any barriers you might face. This information is completely private and only shared with practitioners you match with.

When creating your wellness journey, select the category that best describes what you're looking for (like nutrition, massage, mental health coaching, etc.). We have 22+ wellness categories. You can also select specific subcategories or specialties within that main category to refine your match.

keywords: how do you prefer to meet
knowledgeBase.answer: Tell us how you prefer to work with practitioners. You can choose in-person appointments at their office, house calls (they come to you), virtual sessions online, or flexible (open to any option). We use this to find practitioners who offer your preferred way of connecting.

Let us know your timeline. Are you browsing and exploring? Looking to connect in the next few weeks? Or seeking support more urgently? This helps us prioritize which practitioners to match you with—some specialize in quick connections while others prefer building longer-term relationships.

You can pause onboarding anytime. Your information is saved automatically as you go through the steps. When you come back, just log in and you'll be able to continue from where you left off or see your existing projects on your dashboard.

Yes! You can create multiple wellness projects for different needs. Some clients work with nutrition specialists for diet goals while also connecting with a massage therapist for stress relief. Each project has its own set of matching practitioners.

After you create your wellness project, our matching algorithm automatically finds practitioners who offer the services you need, work in your area or way, and are actively accepting new clients. We show you the top matches, sorted by profile completeness and experience. You can review each one and reach out to practitioners you're interested in.

Once you see practitioners who match what you're looking for, you can send them a connection request. They'll receive a notification about your wellness needs and can choose to accept and connect with you. It's a mutual choice—both of you decide if the fit is right.

When you send a connection request, it goes to the practitioner. They'll review your wellness needs and decide if they can help you. You'll get a notification when they accept and are ready to connect. If they decline, that's okay—we have more practitioners to show you.

If you're having trouble completing onboarding, try refreshing the page. Make sure all required fields are filled in and marked with asterisks (*). If you're still stuck, reach out to our support team and we can help walk you through it or complete it with you.

During onboarding, we collect: your name, email, phone, date of birth, location (zipcode), your wellness goals and challenges, and your preferred communication style. All of this is treated as private health information. We only share details with practitioners you match with, and we never sell your data to third parties.

If you already have a Rooted Vitality account, the onboarding modal will detect this and give you the option to log in instead of signing up again. Just enter your email and password to access your dashboard and existing projects.

When you visit Rooted Vitality for the first time, the onboarding modal appears and asks if you're new or returning. If you're new, we guide you through account creation and project setup. If you're returning, we let you log in to your existing account.

You can close the onboarding modal anytime by clicking the X button in the top-right corner. Your progress will be saved, so when you come back, you can continue from where you left off. There's no pressure to complete it all at once.

Before creating your account, you'll see our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. You must acknowledge that you've read them and agree to our terms. This is important because your health information is sensitive, and we want to make sure you understand how we protect it.
